docs.title: EvoToolkit 2.0
docs.text:
A Python program-search harness built from Evaluator, Proposer, Archive, Strategy and Runner. Search Python modules, kernels, prompts or any text file artifact with one loop and one event format.

Start with the offline example, compose your own components, or read the design.

2.0 removes the 1.x Method/Interface/Task API and pickle checkpoints without compatibility adapters. Pin evotoolkit<2 to stay on 1.x.

docs.title: EvoToolkit 2.0 Design
docs.text:
Status: implemented and released as 2.0.0. Where the implementation deviates from the original draft, the deviation is recorded in the section it belongs to. Usage is documented in extensions.md.

2.0 is a clean break from 1.x: no compatibility shims, no deprecated paths.

docs.title: What EvoToolkit is
docs.text:
A minimal harness for LLM-driven program search. The problem shape it serves:

  • an executable artifact, stored as a set of files (one Python module, a CUDA kernel plus its launcher, a prompt file, ...),
  • an evaluator that runs the artifact and returns a score,
  • a budget (number of proposals, plus a cap on proposer calls; see invariant 6).

Everything the toolkit does is: pick parents from an archive, ask a proposer for new artifacts, evaluate them, record them, repeat.

docs.title: Who uses it
docs.text: User Needs Researcher comparing search strategies Same loop, same budget accounting, same event log for FunSearch, EoH, EvoEngineer, and new strategies. Researcher comparing proposers API model vs coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, ...) on the same task with cost recorded. Practitioner optimizing a kernel or heuristic Write one Evaluator, pick a strategy, run. Analyst Read the JSONL event log; rebuild lineage, score trajectories, stagnation.

docs.title: Usage scenarios
docs.text:
1. Heuristic design for combinatorial optimization. Evaluator averages gap over an instance set.
  2. Kernel or operator optimization (EvoEngineer). Evaluator compiles, checks correctness, profiles.
  3. Mathematical constructions. Evaluator is a checker.
  4. Prompt or configuration search. Evaluator is downstream task score.
  5. Later: meta-level search over the instruction templates themselves. Not built now; the design must not block it.

docs.title: Components
docs.text:
Five components, each answering one question. Arrows show allowed dependencies.

Runner  -->  Strategy  -->  Archive
  |             |
  |             +--->  (instruction templates: data, not code)
  +--->  Proposer
  +--->  Evaluator
  +--->  EventLog
Component Question it answers Knows about Must not know about Evaluator How good is this artifact? the artifact files proposers, archive, threads Proposer Given parents and an instruction, what are some new artifacts? ProposalContext archive, scoring, threads Archive What is stored and how are parents sampled? Solutions and their scores LLMs, prompts, files on disk Strategy This step, which parents and which instruction? Archive, templates LLM calls, threads, files on disk Runner Loop, concurrency, budget, persistence. all of the above prompt text, selection policy

docs.title: Data objects
docs.text:
Files = dict[str, str]          # relative path -> content

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TaskSpec:
    name: str
    prompt: str                 # task description shown to the proposer
    modality: str               # "python" | "cuda" | "string" | ...
    main_file: str              # the file a single-file proposer writes, e.g. "solution.py"
    extras: dict[str, Any]

@dataclass
class EvaluationResult:
    valid: bool
    score: float | None         # higher is better
    feedback: str               # human/LLM readable: errors, profiler output, ...
    metrics: dict[str, Any]     # structured extras, including any objective vector
    cost_seconds: float

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Instruction:
    name: str                   # "i1", "e1", "funsearch", "diff_refine", ...
    num_parents: int
    text: str                   # modality-agnostic; may use {modality}, {main_file}
    output_format: str          # "code_block" | "name_code_thought" | "files"

@dataclass
class ProposalContext:
    spec: TaskSpec
    parents: list["Solution"]
    instruction: Instruction
    best: "Solution | None"
    hints: list[str]            # free-form, e.g. descriptions of other solutions
    num_proposals: int          # how many the strategy wants from this call
    call_id: str                # assigned by the Runner before dispatch; proposers echo it

@dataclass
class Proposal:
    call_id: str                # shared by all proposals from one proposer call
    files: Files
    name: str
    rationale: str
    usage: dict[str, Any]       # per call, not per proposal; dedupe by call_id

@dataclass
class Solution:
    id: str                     # content hash of files, 16 hex chars
    files: Files
    name: str
    rationale: str
    parent_ids: list[str]
    instruction: str            # Instruction.name
    proposer: str               # Proposer.name
    call_id: str
    usage: dict[str, Any]
    evaluation: EvaluationResult | None
    created_step: int

Solution.id = sha256("\0".join(f"{path}\0{content}" for path in sorted(files)))[:16].

The GA labels are gone from the data model. A crossover is an instruction with num_parents=2, a mutation is an instruction with num_parents=1. EoH's five operators and FunSearch's one become rows in a template table.

docs.title: Invariants
docs.text:
1. Log before archive. A Solution is appended to the event log before it is inserted into the archive. The log is append-only.
  2. State is a function of the log. Runner.resume() rebuilds the archive and counters by replaying the log. No pickle.
  3. Strategy is pure. Strategy.next_batch() reads the archive and returns contexts. It performs no I/O, no LLM calls, no threading. Parallelism belongs to the Runner: it tells the Strategy how many slots are free through max_n and calls observe serially, so a Strategy never needs a lock.
  4. Proposer is stateless across calls. Any memory lives in the archive or the log.
  5. Content-addressed identity. Two solutions with identical files have identical id. Archives may reject duplicates; the log still records the attempt.
  6. Budget is counted in the Runner only, in proposals. Strategies see remaining_budget as a number; they never decrement it. A failed proposer call yields zero proposals and does not consume proposal budget; a separate max_calls cap bounds total calls.
  7. The archive is the only shared channel between proposals. Any dependency that does not go through the archive is private to some Proposer and lives in its trace. Dependencies across an evaluation are expressed by the Strategy through observe and the next next_batch; chained proposers compose into one Proposer. The core does not model a dependency graph between proposals.
  8. Evaluators never raise. Failure is valid=False with feedback set. Isolation and timeouts are the Evaluator's job; the Runner only measures cost_seconds and still catches as a last resort.

docs.title: 3. Interface contracts
docs.text:
All contracts are typing.Protocol. Implementations do not inherit.

class Evaluator(Protocol):
    spec: TaskSpec
    def evaluate(self, files: Files) -> EvaluationResult: ...

class Proposer(Protocol):
    name: str
    def propose(self, ctx: ProposalContext) -> list[Proposal]: ...   # may raise

class Archive(Protocol):
    def add(self, solution: Solution) -> None: ...
    def sample(self, n: int, *, rng: np.random.Generator) -> list[Solution]: ...
    def best(self) -> Solution | None: ...
    def __len__(self) -> int: ...

class Strategy(Protocol):
    name: str
    archive: Archive
    def next_batch(self, step: int, max_n: int, remaining_budget: int, rng: np.random.Generator) -> list[ProposalContext]: ...
    def observe(self, solutions: list[Solution]) -> None: ...   # add to archive, trim, etc.
    def should_stop(self, step: int) -> bool: ...

Runner is concrete, not a protocol:

class Runner:
    def __init__(self, *, evaluator, proposer, strategy, output_dir, budget,
                 max_calls=None, propose_workers=4, eval_workers=4,
                 mode="generational", seed=0, verbose=True): ...
    def run(self) -> Solution | None: ...
    def step(self) -> None: ...
    @classmethod
    def resume(cls, output_dir, *, evaluator, proposer, strategy) -> "Runner": ...

Runner.step() does exactly: ctxs = strategy.next_batch(...), push them through the two-stage pipeline, build Solutions, append each to the log, strategy.observe(solutions), bump counters, write checkpoint marker.

Two pipeline stages with independent parallelism:

  1. Propose stage: propose_workers threads call proposer.propose(ctx) concurrently; each call returns a list. An exception becomes a call_failed event.
  2. Evaluate stage: every returned list is split immediately and each item is submitted to eval_workers threads running evaluator.evaluate, without waiting for sibling calls.

Two scheduling modes run the same Strategy unchanged:

  • generational: dispatch a batch, wait for all of it, ask for the next. Behavior of EoH and EvoEngineer; the golden baseline is recorded in this mode.
  • steady: whenever a worker frees up, call next_batch(max_n=1) immediately. Behavior of the original FunSearch and AlphaEvolve. Higher throughput when LLM latency varies or evaluation is fast.

docs.title: Built-in Proposers
docs.text:
• ChatProposer(llm, templates): formats ctx into messages using the instruction's text and output_format, calls the LLM, parses by output_format into Files. code_block and name_code_thought write spec.main_file; files parses several fenced blocks tagged with paths. Absorbs today's six interface files into one template table.
  • AgentProposer(backend, workdir_factory): materializes a workspace (TASK.md describing every parent, the last parent's files, and evaluate.py only when a workdir_factory or evaluation_command supplies one), runs a headless coding agent through headless-cli, reads back the main file and parent paths plus anything declared in ARTIFACTS.json. The transcript is the trace.

docs.title: Built-in Evaluator helpers
docs.text: • subprocess_evaluate(files, entry, timeout): writes files to a temp dir, runs entry in a child process with a timeout, returns stdout/stderr and exit code. Task families opt in; the core does not force isolation.

docs.title: Built-in Archives
docs.text:
• RankedPopulation(max_size): 1.x PopulationState plus rank-based sampling. Deviation: invalid solutions are never stored; 1.x kept them as filler when the population had spare slots.
  • IslandArchive(num_islands, ...): 1.x ProgramsDatabase with two deliberate changes so that resume can rebuild it from the log alone. New solutions route to an island by content hash instead of a random draw, and weak islands reset after every reset_interval accepted unique solutions instead of on a wall-clock timer.

docs.title: Built-in Strategies
docs.text:
• FunSearchStrategy: one instruction, num_parents 2, IslandArchive.
  • EoHStrategy: instructions i1, e1, e2, m1, m2 keeping the original operator semantics, rewritten onto the shared template (which also adds scores, feedback and the current best), RankedPopulation. Deviation: 1.x ran every operator over the whole population each generation; 2.0 cycles the operators across the slots the Runner offers, so one call to next_batch(max_n=4) yields e1, e2, m1, m2.
  • EvoEngineerStrategy: init, crossover, mutation with best-so-far and hints, RankedPopulation.

Each is well under 150 lines.

docs.title: 4. Persistence layout (v1)
docs.text:
<output_dir>/
  events.jsonl            append-only, one JSON object per line
  traces/<call_id>.json   full prompt messages and raw response, or agent transcript

Event types:

{"v": 1, "type": "run_start", "ts": "...", "task": {TaskSpec}, "strategy": "eoh", "proposer": "chat:gpt-4o", "seed": 0, "budget": 45, "config": {"max_calls": 135, "propose_workers": 4, "eval_workers": 4, "mode": "generational", "verbose": true}, "env": {"python": "3.12.1", "platform": "linux", "evotoolkit": "2.0.0"}}
{"v": 1, "type": "call_started", "ts": "...", "step": 3, "call_id": "...", "instruction": "e1", "rng_state": {...}}
{"v": 1, "type": "solution", "ts": "...", "step": 3, "solution": {Solution}}
{"v": 1, "type": "call_failed", "ts": "...", "step": 3, "call_id": "...", "instruction": "e1", "error": "..."}
{"v": 1, "type": "step_end", "ts": "...", "step": 3, "archive_size": 5, "best_id": "ab12...", "best_score": 0.91, "proposals": 4, "valid": 3, "calls": 2, "failed_calls": 0, "rng_state": {...}}
{"v": 1, "type": "run_end", "ts": "...", "status": "completed", "steps": 10, "samples": 45}

call_started and the config and rng_state fields were added during implementation. call_started lets resume count calls that never produced a result, so max_calls survives a crash. rng_state is the numpy bit-generator state taken before each call and at each step end, so parent selection after a resume continues the original random stream instead of restarting it.

Rules: v is bumped on any breaking field change. Readers must ignore unknown fields. Solution.files is stored in full in the log; feedback is truncated to 4 kB by the Runner before the solution reaches the archive, so the live archive, the prompts built from it, and a resumed archive are identical (the log writer keeps a feedback_truncated: true guard for foreign payloads). run_start.config.strategy records the strategy hyperparameters and resume refuses a strategy whose config differs. One call_id is minted by the Runner per call and shared by call_started, call_failed, every resulting solution, and the trace file. Traces are never truncated. An unterminated final line, left by an interrupted process, is skipped by readers and removed the next time the log is opened for writing; any other malformed line is an error.

docs.title: 5. Behavioral baseline
docs.text:
tests/golden/ records, for each built-in strategy with a scripted LLM and a fixed seed: per step, the sorted multiset of (main file content, valid, score, parent ids), the instructions issued, the best score, and the failed-call count; plus final sample, call, and status counters.

The original plan was to record this against 1.x and require 2.0 to reproduce it. That turned out to be impossible by construction: invariant 6 says an unparseable response is a failed call that does not spend budget, whereas 1.x counted it as an invalid sample, so step boundaries and sample counts differ for the same scripted responses. The 1.x snapshots were therefore retired (they remain in git history before the rewrite) and *-v2.json was recorded against 2.0. The weaker evidence that was checked by hand: for all three strategies the set of valid programs produced and the final best score are identical between the 1.x and 2.0 runs.

The v2 files now guard against unintended drift in 2.0, not against drift from 1.x. Re-record them only with a deliberate behavior change, and say so in the commit.

Known ceiling: thread completion order is not deterministic, so the baseline records per-step multisets rather than sequences. Parent selection happens on the main thread before dispatch, and generational batches are handed to observe sorted by id, so archive state and selection are reproducible from the seed (the parent-id column found that island seeding depended on thread completion order before this ordering existed).

docs.title: 6. Deferred decisions
docs.text:
Considered, not built, revisit when a real need appears. Each item names its trigger.

  • Proposal dependency graph. See invariant 7. Trigger: with agents wired in, a dependency shape appears that is neither inside one call nor through the archive.
  • Baseline for steady mode. Results depend on timing, so golden comparison does not apply; only invariants are checked (log solution count equals budget, every parent id appears earlier).
  • Multi-objective selection. score stays a single float, higher is better; objective vectors go in metrics. Multi-objective is a new Archive implementation that samples on metrics. No core change needed. Trigger: a task family and a strategy both need it.
  • Meta-level search. Instruction templates are data and serialize to files, so a template table can be a Solution. The Evaluator runs an inner Runner on a small budget and scores the inner best. Needs nothing from the core beyond what exists. Trigger: someone actually does scenario 5.

docs.title: 7. Decisions
docs.text:
Python, not Node or Rust. Evaluators live in the Python ecosystem (numpy, torch, triton, OR instance libraries). The bottleneck is LLM latency and evaluator runtime, not the harness. Rejected: a Rust core with Python bindings, because it buys nothing measurable and doubles the build surface.

Artifacts are file sets, even for chat proposers. A kernel is a kernel plus a launcher; an agent edits files. A single string would force a second identity scheme later. Single-file tasks set main_file and never notice.

JSONL event log plus trace files, not pickle. Pickle ties checkpoints to class layouts and is unreadable by analysis tools. Full prompts go to traces/ so the log stays small enough to grep. Rejected: SQLite, because a single-writer append-only file is simpler and diffable.

Failed calls do not consume proposal budget. Budget is a research variable; a flaky API should not silently shrink it. max_calls prevents infinite loops.

Isolation is the Evaluator's job. The core offers subprocess_evaluate but does not force it. Task families know their own trust requirements.

Protocol, not ABC. Users should be able to pass any object with the right methods. Rejected: ABC inheritance, because it forces users to import our base classes and couples them to our constructor signatures.

headless-cli subprocess for agents, not per-agent adapters. One dependency already normalizes Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode. Rejected: writing our own adapters, which is maintenance with no research value.

Instructions are data and modality-agnostic. Prompt templates are rows, not subclasses; fences and parsing live in output_format. Six files become one table. This makes EoH's operators and FunSearch's prompt comparable and makes the meta level (scenario 5) a matter of evolving rows.

output_format is a string enum. Parsers are looked up by name inside ChatProposer. Rejected: attaching parser callables to Instruction, because templates must serialize to JSON or YAML.

No 1.x compatibility. Clean break, one release. Rejected: shims and deprecation cycles, because the user base is small and the old surface is the thing being replaced.

No biological vocabulary beyond "evolution". Proposer, Proposal, Archive, Strategy, Evaluator, Instruction. Rejected: gene, capsule, organism, crossover, mutation as core names.

docs.title: Contracts
docs.text:
Implement objects with the following members; inheritance is unnecessary. Types live in evotoolkit.core.

Component Contract Evaluator spec: TaskSpec, evaluate(files) -> EvaluationResult Proposer name: str, propose(ctx: ProposalContext) -> list[Proposal] Archive add(solution), sample(n, *, rng), best(), len(archive) Strategy name, archive, next_batch(step, max_n, remaining_budget, rng), observe(solutions), should_stop(step)

Files is dict[str, str]: relative paths with / separators to text contents. TaskSpec has name, prompt, modality, main_file, and optional extras. Instruction has name, num_parents, text, output_format. Templates interpolate {modality} and {main_file}; escape other literal braces as {{ and }}.

ProposalContext contains spec, parents, instruction, best, hints and num_proposals. Return no more than the requested count. Every Proposal must echo ctx.call_id (the Runner mints it before dispatch and rejects proposals carrying any other ID); proposals from one call share it and the usage dictionary. A Solution adds content hash identity, parent IDs, proposer and instruction names, evaluation and created_step. Use Solution.create(...) for new solutions and to_dict/from_dict for serialization; unknown fields are ignored when reading.

Strategy code runs serially on the Runner thread; proposal and evaluation calls run concurrently. Use the supplied RNG for selection. Keep replayable state in the archive and observe, not in next_batch. Evaluators must enforce their own timeouts and return invalid results on failure; Runner catches exceptions as a fallback. A valid score must be finite. Put extra objectives in metrics.

docs.title: Built-ins
docs.text:
• RankedPopulation(max_size=5): finite valid unique solutions, descending scores and rank-weighted sampling with replacement.
  • IslandArchive(num_islands=5, reset_interval=30000, ...): score clusters, temperature-weighted sampling, shorter artifacts within clusters. The first valid candidate seeds every island. Content hashes route later candidates; accepted unique solution counts trigger weak-island resets. These deterministic rules replace v1's sampled-island routing and wall-clock resets so replay reconstructs the archive.
  • EvoEngineerStrategy(spec, pop_size=5): init, crossover and mutation, best candidate and rationale hints.
  • EoHStrategy(spec, pop_size=5, selection_num=2): i1, e1, e2, m1, m2 instructions.
  • FunSearchStrategy(spec, num_islands=5, num_parents=2, reset_interval=30000): island sampling with one improvement instruction.

The built-ins stop on Runner's budget/call cap. For a custom stop criterion implement should_stop(step) in your strategy.

docs.title: Chat proposer
docs.text:
ChatProposer(llm, templates=None, *, eventlog=None) uses llm.get_response(messages) -> (text, usage). Pass a mapping of instruction names to Instruction objects to override templates. Defaults are data in evotoolkit.proposers.templates.INSTRUCTIONS.

Output formats:

  • code_block: exactly one fenced block, written to spec.main_file; optional leading {rationale}.
  • name_code_thought: name: before one code fence, then thought: after it.
  • files: multiple fences with a relative path directly after the opening fence, such as ```src/main.py.

Multiple alternatives are separated by a line containing only ===PROPOSAL===. The number must equal ctx.num_proposals. Parse errors are failed calls, preserved in full traces. Runner attaches its EventLog to built-in proposers automatically.

docs.title: Agent proposer
docs.text:
AgentProposer(backend, workdir_factory=None, *, timeout=600, eventlog=None) requires the separate executable installed by:

npm install -g @roberttlange/headless

Authenticate your chosen backend separately. The adapter uses headless <backend> --prompt-file TASK.md --work-dir DIR --json --usage --timeout N, as specified by the upstream CLI documentation.

Each call is a fresh workspace and returns one candidate; request num_proposals=1. The last parent's files seed the workspace, while TASK.md describes every parent and the instruction. A custom workdir_factory(ctx) returns a context manager yielding a dedicated directory; it may provide evaluate.py and support files. Alternatively spec.extras['evaluation_command'] can contain an argv list used to generate evaluate.py. Without either, evaluation occurs after proposal generation.

TASK.md, evaluate.py and factory support files are harness inputs. Returned artifacts default to the main file and existing parent artifact paths. To add or remove files, the agent writes a JSON array of relative output paths to ARTIFACTS.json; this manifest is not itself an artifact. This keeps unrelated workspace outputs out of the proposal.

Headless uses backend auto-approval. Temporary workspaces and subprocesses are not security sandboxes; provide OS/container isolation appropriate to the generated code. The adapter does not install agents or manage credentials.

docs.title: Evaluating programs
docs.text:
from evotoolkit.evaluators import subprocess_evaluate provides an opt-in helper:

result = subprocess_evaluate({"main.py": "print(42)"}, "main.py", timeout=5)
assert result.returncode == 0
assert result.stdout.strip() == "42"

A string entry is a relative Python filename; an argv list runs an explicit command. The helper writes validated relative paths into a temporary directory and returns subprocess.CompletedProcess. Timeout uses return code 124; setup failures use 1. stdout/stderr are preserved. Timeout terminates the direct child; process-tree containment remains the evaluator's responsibility.

docs.title: Event log
docs.text:
EventLog supports run_start, call_started, solution, call_failed, step_end and run_end. An unterminated final line left by an interrupted process is skipped by readers and removed when the log is next opened for writing; any other malformed line raises an error. Readers ignore unknown fields. Writes are flushed but not fsynced. Do not run two writers against one output directory.

Resume checks the task, component names and the strategy's config (its constructor hyperparameters); callers must still supply the original proposer configuration. Logged solutions rebuild state; results that never reached the log are lost. RNG snapshots retain selection progress, but live scheduling and external model responses remain nondeterministic.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
Python 3.10 or newer is required.

pip install evotoolkit

To work from a checkout instead:

uv sync --group dev
uv run pytest tests/

The core dependency is NumPy. Chat models use any client exposing get_response(messages); the included HttpsApi speaks the chat-completions wire format. Model access requires your own endpoint and credentials.

AgentProposer additionally requires a separate headless-cli installation and authenticated backend. See Extensions. No agent dependency is installed by importing EvoToolkit.

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
From a checkout, run uv sync --group dev, then a deterministic local search:

uv run python examples/custom_task/my_custom_task.py --offline --output-dir results/demo
uv run python examples/custom_task/my_custom_task.py --offline --mode steady --output-dir results/steady

The example supplies twelve proposals, scores a Python function against sin(x), and prints the best artifact. Set LLM_API_KEY (plus optional LLM_API_URL, LLM_MODEL) and omit --offline for live calls.

docs.title: Compose a search
docs.text:
from evotoolkit import EvaluationResult, Runner, TaskSpec
from evotoolkit.proposers import ChatProposer
from evotoolkit.strategies import EvoEngineerStrategy

class GreetingEvaluator:
    spec = TaskSpec("greeting", "Write hello in answer.txt.", "string", "answer.txt")

    def evaluate(self, files):
        return EvaluationResult(True, float(files.get("answer.txt", "").strip() == "hello"), "")

# llm.get_response(messages) returns (response_text, usage_dict).
evaluator = GreetingEvaluator()
proposer = ChatProposer(llm)
strategy = EvoEngineerStrategy(evaluator.spec)
runner = Runner(evaluator=evaluator, proposer=proposer, strategy=strategy,
                output_dir="results/greeting", budget=20, seed=42,
                propose_workers=4, eval_workers=4, mode="generational")
best = runner.run()

Replace the strategy with EoHStrategy(spec) or FunSearchStrategy(spec) without changing the loop. Scores are scalar and higher is better. Invalid results use EvaluationResult(False, None, feedback).

docs.title: Budgets and concurrency
docs.text:
budget counts evaluated proposals, including invalid and duplicate artifacts. Failed/empty/malformed calls produce call_failed events without consuming proposal budget. max_calls bounds all dispatched calls, including calls interrupted by a crash; its default is max(1, 3 * budget). Each context reserves its requested proposals, so concurrent calls cannot exceed the remaining budget. Returning more than requested rejects the entire call.

generational selects a batch from the current archive and observes its results before the next batch. steady refills available proposer workers continuously and observes each completed evaluation. Both feed evaluation workers immediately when an individual proposer call finishes. step() executes one bounded batch; run() enables continuous steady scheduling.

runner.samples, calls, failed_calls, steps, status, and best_solution expose progress. Final status is completed when the proposal budget is used, max_calls when the call cap is reached, or stopped when the strategy stops or yields no work. run() closes the log; manual stepping should use a context manager or call close().

docs.title: Resume
docs.text:
runner = Runner.resume("results/greeting", evaluator=evaluator,
                       proposer=ChatProposer(llm), strategy=EvoEngineerStrategy(evaluator.spec))
best = runner.run()

Supply a fresh empty strategy with the same parameters. Task specification and component names must match. Budget, scheduling, worker counts and RNG state come from the event log. Completed solutions rebuild the archive; unfinished calls consume the call cap but not proposal budget. Resume cannot restore an external model's hidden state or guarantee identical completion order.

events.jsonl contains full artifact files, evaluations, parent IDs, counters and checkpoint RNG state. traces/<call_id>.json contains full prompts, responses or agent transcripts. Feedback in solution events is limited to 4 KiB; traces are untruncated. Call usage is per call: deduplicate Solution.call_id when totaling tokens.

docs.title: EvoToolkit 2.0
docs.text:
由 Evaluator、Proposer、Archive、Strategy 和 Runner 组成的 Python 程序搜索工具。统一循环和事件格式，搜索 Python 模块、内核、提示或其他文本文件产物。

先运行离线示例，再组装自己的组件，或阅读设计。

2.0 移除了 1.x 的 Method/Interface/Task API 和 pickle 检查点，不提供兼容层。需要留在 1.x 的用户请固定 evotoolkit<2。

docs.title: EvoToolkit 2.0 设计
docs.text:
状态：已实现并作为 2.0.0 发布。实现与原草案不一致的地方，都记在它所属的小节里。使用方式见 extensions.zh.md。

2.0 与 1.x 彻底切断：没有兼容 shim，没有弃用路径。 英文版见 design.md，以英文版为准。

docs.title: EvoToolkit 是什么
docs.text:
一个最小化的 LLM 驱动程序搜索 harness。它服务的问题形状是：

  • 一个可执行的产物，以文件集的形式存储（一个 Python 模块、一个 CUDA 内核加它的 launcher、一个 prompt 文件……），
  • 一个评估器，运行产物并返回分数，
  • 一个预算（提案次数，外加 proposer 调用次数上限；见不变量 6）。

工具做的全部事情就是：从 archive 里挑父代，让 proposer 产出新产物，评估它们，记录它们，重复。

docs.title: 谁用它
docs.text: 用户 需要什么 对比搜索策略的研究者 FunSearch、EoH、EvoEngineer 和新策略跑在同一个循环、同一套预算记账、同一种事件日志上。 对比 proposer 的研究者 API 模型和 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex……）在同一任务上对比，成本有记录。 优化内核或启发式的实践者 写一个 Evaluator，选一个策略，跑。 分析者 读 JSONL 事件日志，重建谱系、分数轨迹、停滞情况。

docs.title: 使用场景
docs.text:
1. 组合优化的启发式设计。评估器在实例集上取平均 gap。
  2. 内核或算子优化（EvoEngineer）。评估器负责编译、正确性检查、profiling。
  3. 数学构造。评估器是 checker。
  4. prompt 或配置搜索。评估器是下游任务分数。
  5. 以后：对指令模板本身做元层面搜索。现在不做，但设计不能堵死它。

docs.title: 组件
docs.text:
五个组件，每个只回答一个问题。箭头表示允许的依赖方向。

Runner  -->  Strategy  -->  Archive
  |             |
  |             +--->  (指令模板：是数据，不是代码)
  +--->  Proposer
  +--->  Evaluator
  +--->  EventLog
组件 回答的问题 知道什么 不许知道什么 Evaluator 这个产物多好？ 产物的文件 proposer、archive、线程 Proposer 给定父代和指令，能产出哪些新产物？ ProposalContext archive、打分、线程 Archive 存什么、怎么采样父代？ Solution 和分数 LLM、prompt、磁盘文件 Strategy 这一步选哪些父代、下什么指令？ Archive、模板 LLM 调用、线程、磁盘文件 Runner 循环、并发、预算、持久化。 以上全部 prompt 文本、选择策略

docs.title: 数据对象
docs.text:
Files = dict[str, str]          # 相对路径 -> 内容

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TaskSpec:
    name: str
    prompt: str                 # 给 proposer 看的任务描述
    modality: str               # "python" | "cuda" | "string" | ...
    main_file: str              # 单文件 proposer 写的那个文件，如 "solution.py"
    extras: dict[str, Any]

@dataclass
class EvaluationResult:
    valid: bool
    score: float | None         # 越大越好
    feedback: str               # 人和 LLM 可读：报错、profiler 输出……
    metrics: dict[str, Any]     # 结构化的附加指标，包括任何目标向量
    cost_seconds: float

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Instruction:
    name: str                   # "i1", "e1", "funsearch", "diff_refine", ...
    num_parents: int
    text: str                   # 与模态无关；可用 {modality}、{main_file} 占位
    output_format: str          # "code_block" | "name_code_thought" | "files"

@dataclass
class ProposalContext:
    spec: TaskSpec
    parents: list["Solution"]
    instruction: Instruction
    best: "Solution | None"
    hints: list[str]            # 自由文本，例如其他解的描述
    num_proposals: int          # Strategy 这次想要几个提案
    call_id: str                # Runner 分发前分配，proposer 原样回填

@dataclass
class Proposal:
    call_id: str                # 同一次 proposer 调用产出的提案共享
    files: Files
    name: str
    rationale: str
    usage: dict[str, Any]       # 按调用记，不按提案记；用 call_id 去重

@dataclass
class Solution:
    id: str                     # 文件内容哈希，取 16 位十六进制
    files: Files
    name: str
    rationale: str
    parent_ids: list[str]
    instruction: str            # Instruction.name
    proposer: str               # Proposer.name
    call_id: str
    usage: dict[str, Any]
    evaluation: EvaluationResult | None
    created_step: int

Solution.id = sha256("\0".join(f"{path}\0{content}" for path in sorted(files)))[:16]。

数据模型里不再有 GA 的标签。crossover 就是 num_parents=2 的指令，mutation 就是 num_parents=1 的指令。EoH 的五个算子和 FunSearch 的一个算子都变成模板表里的行。

docs.title: 不变量
docs.text:
1. 先写日志再进 archive。 Solution 先追加进事件日志，再插入 archive。日志只追加不修改。
  2. 状态是日志的函数。 Runner.resume() 通过重放日志重建 archive 和计数器。不用 pickle。
  3. Strategy 是纯的。 Strategy.next_batch() 读 archive、返回 context。不做 I/O，不调 LLM，不开线程。并行度完全归 Runner：Runner 通过 max_n 告诉 Strategy 现在有几个空位，并且串行调用 observe，所以 Strategy 内部永远不需要锁。
  4. Proposer 跨调用无状态。 任何记忆都放在 archive 或日志里。
  5. 内容寻址的身份。 文件完全相同的两个解 id 相同。archive 可以拒绝重复，但日志仍然记录这次尝试。
  6. 预算只在 Runner 里计数，按提案数计。 Strategy 看到的 remaining_budget 是一个数字，它从不扣减。失败的 proposer 调用产出零个提案，不消耗提案预算；另有 max_calls 上限约束总调用次数。
  7. 提案之间唯一的共享通道是 archive。 任何不经过 archive 的依赖都是某个 Proposer 内部的事，记录在它的 trace 里。跨评估的依赖由 Strategy 通过 observe 和下一次 next_batch 表达；多个 proposer 串联则组合成一个 Proposer。核心不建模提案之间的依赖图。
  8. Evaluator 永不抛异常。 失败就是 valid=False 并填写 feedback。隔离和超时是 Evaluator 的职责；Runner 只测 cost_seconds，并作为最后兜底捕获异常。

docs.title: 3. 接口契约
docs.text:
所有契约都是 typing.Protocol。实现方不继承。

class Evaluator(Protocol):
    spec: TaskSpec
    def evaluate(self, files: Files) -> EvaluationResult: ...

class Proposer(Protocol):
    name: str
    def propose(self, ctx: ProposalContext) -> list[Proposal]: ...   # 可以抛异常

class Archive(Protocol):
    def add(self, solution: Solution) -> None: ...
    def sample(self, n: int, *, rng: np.random.Generator) -> list[Solution]: ...
    def best(self) -> Solution | None: ...
    def __len__(self) -> int: ...

class Strategy(Protocol):
    name: str
    archive: Archive
    def next_batch(self, step: int, max_n: int, remaining_budget: int, rng: np.random.Generator) -> list[ProposalContext]: ...
    def observe(self, solutions: list[Solution]) -> None: ...   # 加进 archive、裁剪等
    def should_stop(self, step: int) -> bool: ...

Runner 是具体类，不是 protocol：

class Runner:
    def __init__(self, *, evaluator, proposer, strategy, output_dir, budget,
                 max_calls=None, propose_workers=4, eval_workers=4,
                 mode="generational", seed=0, verbose=True): ...
    def run(self) -> Solution | None: ...
    def step(self) -> None: ...
    @classmethod
    def resume(cls, output_dir, *, evaluator, proposer, strategy) -> "Runner": ...

Runner.step() 只做这些事：ctxs = strategy.next_batch(...)，把它们送进两级流水线，构造 Solution，逐个追加到日志，strategy.observe(solutions)，更新计数器，写 checkpoint 标记。

两级流水线，并行度各自独立：

  1. 提案级：propose_workers 个线程并发调用 proposer.propose(ctx)，每次调用返回一个列表。抛异常则记一条 call_failed 事件。
  2. 评估级：每个返回的列表立即拆开，逐个提交给 eval_workers 个线程跑 evaluator.evaluate，不等同批其他调用。

两种调度模式，同一个 Strategy 都能跑：

  • generational：发一批，等全部回来，再要下一批。EoH 和 EvoEngineer 的行为，golden 基线按它录。
  • steady：哪个 worker 空了就立刻 next_batch(max_n=1) 再要一个，不等别人。FunSearch 原版和 AlphaEvolve 的行为。LLM 延迟方差大或评估很快时吞吐更高。

docs.title: 内置 Proposer
docs.text:
• ChatProposer(llm, templates)：用指令的 text 和 output_format 把 ctx 格式化成 messages，调 LLM，按 output_format 解析成 Files。code_block 和 name_code_thought 写入 spec.main_file；files 解析多个带路径标记的围栏块。把现在的六个 interface 文件吸收成一张模板表。
  • AgentProposer(backend, workdir_factory)：物化一个工作区（TASK.md 描述全部父代，落盘最后一个父代的文件，evaluate.py 仅在 workdir_factory 或 evaluation_command 提供时生成），通过 headless-cli 跑 headless coding agent，读回主文件、父代路径以及 ARTIFACTS.json 声明的文件。agent 轨迹就是 trace。

docs.title: 内置 Evaluator 辅助
docs.text: • subprocess_evaluate(files, entry, timeout)：把文件写进临时目录，在子进程里带超时运行 entry，返回 stdout、stderr 和退出码。任务族自行选用；核心不强制隔离。

docs.title: 内置 Archive
docs.text:
• RankedPopulation(max_size)：1.x 的 PopulationState 加基于排名的采样。偏离：无效解一律不存；1.x 在种群有空位时会用无效解填充。
  • IslandArchive(num_islands, ...)：1.x 的 ProgramsDatabase，为了让 resume 只靠日志就能重建，做了两处有意的改动。新解按内容哈希分配到岛屿，而不是随机抽；弱岛在每累计 reset_interval 个被接受的唯一解后重置，而不是按墙钟定时。

docs.title: 内置 Strategy
docs.text:
• FunSearchStrategy：一个指令，num_parents 2，IslandArchive。
  • EoHStrategy：指令 i1、e1、e2、m1、m2，保留算子语义、统一改写到共享模板（模板还会加入分数、反馈和当前最优），RankedPopulation。偏离：1.x 每代把每个算子在整个种群上跑一遍；2.0 把算子轮流分配到 Runner 给出的空位上，一次 next_batch(max_n=4) 得到 e1、e2、m1、m2 各一个。
  • EvoEngineerStrategy：init、crossover、mutation，带当前最优和 hints，RankedPopulation。

每个都远少于 150 行。

docs.title: 4. 持久化布局（v1）
docs.text:
<output_dir>/
  events.jsonl            只追加，每行一个 JSON 对象
  traces/<call_id>.json   完整的 prompt messages 和原始回复，或 agent 轨迹

事件类型：

{"v": 1, "type": "run_start", "ts": "...", "task": {TaskSpec}, "strategy": "eoh", "proposer": "chat:gpt-4o", "seed": 0, "budget": 45, "config": {"max_calls": 135, "propose_workers": 4, "eval_workers": 4, "mode": "generational", "verbose": true}, "env": {"python": "3.12.1", "platform": "linux", "evotoolkit": "2.0.0"}}
{"v": 1, "type": "call_started", "ts": "...", "step": 3, "call_id": "...", "instruction": "e1", "rng_state": {...}}
{"v": 1, "type": "solution", "ts": "...", "step": 3, "solution": {Solution}}
{"v": 1, "type": "call_failed", "ts": "...", "step": 3, "call_id": "...", "instruction": "e1", "error": "..."}
{"v": 1, "type": "step_end", "ts": "...", "step": 3, "archive_size": 5, "best_id": "ab12...", "best_score": 0.91, "proposals": 4, "valid": 3, "calls": 2, "failed_calls": 0, "rng_state": {...}}
{"v": 1, "type": "run_end", "ts": "...", "status": "completed", "steps": 10, "samples": 45}

call_started 事件和 config、rng_state 字段是实现期间加的。call_started 让 resume 能数到那些没产出结果的调用，max_calls 在崩溃后仍然有效。rng_state 是 numpy 位生成器在每次调用前和每步结束时的状态，恢复后父代选择沿着原来的随机流继续，而不是从头开始。

规则：任何破坏性字段变更都要升 v。读取方必须忽略未知字段。Solution.files 在日志里完整保存；feedback 由 Runner 在解进入 archive 之前截断到 4 kB，因此运行中的 archive、据此生成的 prompt 和恢复后的 archive 完全一致（日志写入方保留 feedback_truncated: true 兜底）。run_start.config.strategy 记录策略超参数，resume 拒绝 config 不一致的策略。每次调用的 call_id 由 Runner 生成一次，call_started、call_failed、所有产出的 solution 和 trace 文件共用。trace 永不截断。进程被打断留下的末尾半行，读取方跳过，下一次以写模式打开日志时删除；其他格式错误的行一律报错。

docs.title: 5. 行为基线
docs.text:
tests/golden/ 用脚本化 LLM 和固定种子，为每个内置策略记录：每一步的 (主文件内容, valid, score, 父代 id) 排序多重集、下发的指令、最优分数、失败调用数；以及最终的样本数、调用数和状态。

原计划是用 1.x 录制、要求 2.0 复现。这在构造上做不到：不变量 6 规定无法解析的回复是一次失败调用、不扣预算，而 1.x 把它算作一个无效样本，所以同样的脚本化回复下，步骤边界和样本数必然不同。因此 1.x 快照已退役（重写前的 git 历史里还有），*-v2.json 改为用 2.0 录制。人工核对过的较弱证据：三个策略在 1.x 和 2.0 下产出的有效程序集合和最终最优分完全一致。

v2 文件现在防的是 2.0 自身的意外漂移，不是相对 1.x 的漂移。只有在有意改变行为时才重录，并在提交信息里说明。

已知上限：线程完成顺序不确定，所以基线记录的是每步的多重集而不是序列。父代选择发生在主线程、分发之前，且 generational 批次按 id 排序后再交给 observe，所以 archive 状态和选择都能由种子复现（加入父代 id 列后，才发现岛屿播种此前依赖线程完成顺序）。

docs.title: 6. 推迟的决定
docs.text:
考虑过、暂不做、等到有真实需求再回头看的东西。每条写清楚触发条件。

  • 提案依赖图。 见不变量 7。触发条件：接入 agent 后，出现一种依赖形态既不在一次调用内部、又不经过 archive。
  • steady 模式的基线。 结果依赖时序，不能用 golden 对比，只能验证不变量（日志解数等于预算、每个解的父代 id 都在它之前出现）。
  • 多目标选择。 score 保持单个浮点数、越大越好；目标向量放 metrics。多目标是一个按 metrics 采样的新 Archive 实现，核心不用改。触发条件：某个任务族和某个策略都需要它。
  • 元层面搜索。 指令模板是数据，能序列化成文件，所以一张模板表可以当 Solution。它的 Evaluator 用小预算跑一个内层 Runner，给内层最优打分。核心已有的东西够用。触发条件：场景 5 有人真的要做。

docs.title: 7. 决策
docs.text:
Python，不是 Node 或 Rust。 评估器活在 Python 生态里（numpy、torch、triton、运筹实例库）。瓶颈是 LLM 延迟和评估器运行时间，不是 harness。放弃：Rust 核心加 Python 绑定，因为换不来任何可测量的收益，还让构建面翻倍。

产物是文件集，chat proposer 也一样。 内核是内核加 launcher；agent 改的是文件。单字符串以后会逼出第二套身份方案。单文件任务设好 main_file 就感觉不到差别。

JSONL 事件日志加 trace 文件，不是 pickle。 pickle 把 checkpoint 绑死在类布局上，分析工具也读不了。完整 prompt 放 traces/，日志保持可 grep 的体积。放弃：SQLite，因为单写者的追加文件更简单、可 diff。

失败的调用不消耗提案预算。 预算是研究变量，一个不稳定的 API 不该悄悄把它吃掉。max_calls 防死循环。

隔离是 Evaluator 的职责。 核心提供 subprocess_evaluate 但不强制。任务族自己知道自己的信任要求。

Protocol，不是 ABC。 用户应该能传任何有正确方法的对象。放弃：ABC 继承，因为它迫使用户导入我们的基类，并绑定到我们的构造函数签名。

用 headless-cli 子进程接 agent，不写逐个 agent 的适配器。 一个依赖已经统一了 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini、OpenCode。放弃：自己写适配器，那是没有研究价值的维护工作。

指令是数据，且与模态无关。 prompt 模板是行，不是子类；围栏和解析放在 output_format。六个文件收成一张表。这让 EoH 的算子和 FunSearch 的 prompt 可比，也让元层面（场景 5）变成「进化这些行」的问题。

output_format 是字符串枚举。 解析器在 ChatProposer 里按名字查表。放弃：把解析函数挂在 Instruction 上，因为模板必须能序列化成 JSON 或 YAML。

不兼容 1.x。 一次发版彻底切断。放弃：shim 和弃用周期，因为用户基数小，而且旧表面正是要被替换的东西。

除了 evolution 之外不用生物学词汇。 Proposer、Proposal、Archive、Strategy、Evaluator、Instruction。放弃：gene、capsule、organism、crossover、mutation 作为核心名字。

docs.title: 组件契约
docs.text:
不要求继承基类；实现相应成员即可。类型从 evotoolkit.core 导入。

组件 成员 Evaluator spec: TaskSpec；evaluate(files) -> EvaluationResult Proposer name；propose(ctx) -> list[Proposal] Archive add(solution)；sample(n, *, rng)；best()；len(archive) Strategy name、archive；next_batch(step, max_n, remaining_budget, rng)；observe(solutions)；should_stop(step)

Files 为相对路径到文本内容的字典，路径用 / 分隔。TaskSpec 包含 name、prompt、modality、main_file、extras。Instruction 包含 name、num_parents、text、output_format。模板可替换 {modality}、{main_file}；其他字面花括号需写作 {{、}}。

ProposalContext 包含任务、父代、指令、最佳解、提示和请求数量。每个 Proposal 必须原样回填 ctx.call_id（由 Runner 在分发前生成，携带其他 ID 的提案会被拒绝）；同一调用的提案共享该 ID 和 usage；返回数量不得超过请求。Solution 添加内容哈希、父代 ID、指令与 proposer 名、评估和步号；新解使用 Solution.create(...)，序列化使用 to_dict/from_dict，读取时忽略未知字段。

策略在主线程串行执行，提案器和评估器会并发调用。选择操作使用传入的 RNG；需恢复的状态放入 archive，通过 observe 更新。评估器自行处理超时和隔离，失败返回无效结果，Runner 另有异常兜底。有效分数必须有限且越大越好，多目标信息放入 metrics。

docs.title: 内置组件
docs.text:
• RankedPopulation(max_size=5)：只保存有效、有限分数、内容唯一的解；排名加权有放回采样。
  • IslandArchive(num_islands=5, reset_interval=30000, ...)：分数聚类、温度采样、簇内偏好短产物。首个有效解播种所有岛；后续按内容哈希分配，并按已接受的唯一解数量重置弱岛。它替代旧版的采样岛分配和墙钟重置，以保证日志重放。
  • EvoEngineerStrategy(spec, pop_size=5)：init、crossover、mutation，附带最佳解和思路提示。
  • EoHStrategy(spec, pop_size=5, selection_num=2)：i1、e1、e2、m1、m2。
  • FunSearchStrategy(spec, num_islands=5, num_parents=2, reset_interval=30000)：岛屿父代采样和改进指令。

内置策略由 Runner 的预算或调用上限停止；自定义停止规则实现 should_stop。

docs.title: ChatProposer
docs.text:
ChatProposer(llm, templates=None, *, eventlog=None) 调用 llm.get_response(messages)，返回 (text, usage)。templates 是指令名到 Instruction 的覆盖表；默认模板位于 evotoolkit.proposers.templates.INSTRUCTIONS。

  • code_block：一个 fenced block，写入 main_file，可在前面写 {思路}。
  • name_code_thought：代码块前写 name:，后写 thought:。
  • files：每个文件一个代码块，开头标签直接写相对路径，例如 src/main.py。

同调用的多个候选用独占一行的 ===PROPOSAL=== 分隔，数量必须等于请求数量。解析失败记录为失败调用，并保留完整 trace。Runner 自动为内置 proposer 绑定 EventLog。

docs.title: AgentProposer
docs.text:
AgentProposer(backend, workdir_factory=None, *, timeout=600, eventlog=None) 使用单独安装的 headless-cli：

npm install -g @roberttlange/headless

后端认证需自行配置。实际命令是 headless <backend> --prompt-file TASK.md --work-dir DIR --json --usage --timeout N，见上游文档。

每次调用一个独立工作目录，产生一个文件集；num_proposals 必须为 1。最后一个父代的文件写入目录，全部父代及指令写入 TASK.md。workdir_factory(ctx) 可返回产出专用目录的上下文管理器，其中可预置 evaluate.py 和支持文件；或在 spec.extras['evaluation_command'] 提供 argv 列表以生成 evaluate.py。都未配置时，仅在生成后由 Runner 评估。

TASK.md、evaluate.py 及工厂支持文件属于输入，不会作为产物返回。默认只返回 main_file 和已有父代文件；增删文件时由 agent 在 ARTIFACTS.json 中写出相对输出路径的 JSON 数组，清单本身不是产物。这能避免把工作目录里的无关输出误收集为候选。

headless 使用后端自动批准模式；临时目录和子进程不是安全沙箱，运行不可信代码时应由调用方提供 OS 或容器隔离。适配器不安装后端、不管理认证。

docs.title: 子进程评估
docs.text:
from evotoolkit.evaluators import subprocess_evaluate
result = subprocess_evaluate({"main.py": "print(42)"}, "main.py", timeout=5)
assert result.returncode == 0

entry 字符串表示相对 Python 入口文件，argv 列表表示显式命令。返回 CompletedProcess，含 stdout、stderr、returncode；超时码为 124，准备失败为 1。文件路径经过校验。超时终止直接子进程，不负责完整进程树隔离。

docs.title: 日志与恢复
docs.text:
事件类型包括 run_start、call_started、solution、call_failed、step_end、run_end。进程被打断留下的末尾半行，读取时跳过，下次以写模式打开日志时删除；其他格式错误的行会报错。写入使用 flush，没有 fsync；同一目录只允许一个运行写入。

恢复检查任务规格、组件名称以及策略的 config（构造超参数）；调用方仍需提供原 proposer 配置。已落盘结果可重建状态，未落盘结果无法恢复。RNG 快照保留选择进度，但并发完成顺序和外部模型响应仍可能变化。

docs.title: 安装
docs.text:
需要 Python 3.10 或更新版本。

pip install evotoolkit

从源码仓库开发：

uv sync --group dev
uv run pytest tests/

核心仅依赖 NumPy。ChatProposer 可接收任意提供 get_response(messages) 的客户端；内置 HttpsApi 使用 chat-completions 格式。真实模型访问需要配置自己的地址和密钥。

AgentProposer 另需安装 headless-cli 并认证对应后端，详见扩展。导入 EvoToolkit 不会安装 agent 依赖。

docs.title: 快速开始
docs.text:
在仓库中执行：

uv sync --group dev
uv run python examples/custom_task/my_custom_task.py --offline --output-dir results/demo
uv run python examples/custom_task/my_custom_task.py --offline --mode steady --output-dir results/steady

离线示例无需密钥：生成 12 个 Python 函数提案，在子进程中计算与 sin(x) 的误差，返回最佳文件。真实模型调用需设置 LLM_API_KEY，可选 LLM_API_URL、LLM_MODEL，并去掉 --offline。

docs.title: 组装搜索
docs.text:
from evotoolkit import EvaluationResult, Runner, TaskSpec
from evotoolkit.proposers import ChatProposer
from evotoolkit.strategies import EvoEngineerStrategy

class GreetingEvaluator:
    spec = TaskSpec("greeting", "在 answer.txt 中写 hello。", "string", "answer.txt")

    def evaluate(self, files):
        return EvaluationResult(True, float(files.get("answer.txt", "").strip() == "hello"), "")

# llm.get_response(messages) 返回 (响应文本, usage 字典)。
evaluator = GreetingEvaluator()
runner = Runner(evaluator=evaluator, proposer=ChatProposer(llm),
                strategy=EvoEngineerStrategy(evaluator.spec), output_dir="results/greeting",
                budget=20, seed=42, propose_workers=4, eval_workers=4,
                mode="generational")
best = runner.run()

可直接替换为 EoHStrategy(spec) 或 FunSearchStrategy(spec)。分数越大越好；失败返回 EvaluationResult(False, None, feedback)。

docs.title: 预算与并发
docs.text:
budget 统计实际提案，包含评估无效和重复文件。失败、空返回或解析失败的调用记录为 call_failed，不扣提案预算。max_calls 限制全部调用，默认 max(1, 3 * budget)；崩溃时未完成的调用也计入。Runner 预留在途提案额度，避免并发超预算。返回数量超过请求数量时拒绝整个调用。

generational 一批全部完成后更新档案并选择下一批；steady 持续填补空闲 proposer worker，每个评估完成后立即更新档案。单个调用完成即可进入独立评估线程池，无需等待其他调用。step() 执行一个有限批次，run() 才持续调度 steady 模式。

runner.samples、calls、failed_calls、steps、status、best_solution 提供进展。状态分别为预算耗尽 completed、调用上限 max_calls、策略停止或无任务 stopped。run() 自动关闭日志；手动逐步执行时使用上下文管理器或 close()。

docs.title: 恢复
docs.text:
runner = Runner.resume("results/greeting", evaluator=evaluator,
                       proposer=ChatProposer(llm), strategy=EvoEngineerStrategy(evaluator.spec))
best = runner.run()

传入同配置的新策略，档案必须为空。任务规格及组件名称需一致。预算、线程数、调度模式和随机数状态从日志恢复；已落盘结果重建档案，未完成调用只占调用额度。外部模型状态和线程完成顺序无法恢复，因此不承诺继续运行的结果逐位一致。

events.jsonl 保存完整文件、评估、父代、计数器和随机数状态。traces/<call_id>.json 保存完整提示、响应或 agent 转录。事件中的反馈限长 4 KiB，trace 不截断。usage 按调用计算，汇总 token 时应按 Solution.call_id 去重。
